entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two of you spend some time relaxing on the beach.
The air is fresh, the sand shimmers, and the surf roars softly.*#WHITE#

This was such a lovely idea!
I have had a wonderful time with you today.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks longingly into your eyes.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你们两个在沙滩上放松了一阵子。
空气清新，沙滩闪闪发光，海浪发出轻柔的涛声。*#WHITE#

来海边真是个好主意！
今天和你玩得很开心啊。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*她含情脉脉地凝视着你。*#WHITE#

entries.source:
You have reached your maximum number of inscriptions (infusions/runes).
If you have unassigned #{bold}#talent category points#{normal}# you can use one to create a new slot (up to 5).
You can replace an existing one or cancel.
The old inscription will be lost.
entries.target:
你的刻印（纹身/符文）数量已经达到上限。
如果你还有未分配的#{bold}#技能树解锁点#{normal}#，可以花费 1 个来创建新刻印位（最多 5 个）。
你可以替换一个现有刻印，也可以取消。
旧刻印将会消失。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a small humanoid creature with a disproportionate head.*#WHITE#
Ah, what have we here? @playerdescriptor.race@, I believe you have turned at the wrong corner.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个矮小的人形生物，脑袋与身体的比例很不协调。*#WHITE#
啊，看看谁来了？@playerdescriptor.race@，我想你是走错地方了。

entries.source: So it would seem. What is going on here?
entries.target: 看起来确实如此。这里发生了什么事？

entries.source:
This is my Ring of Blood! Listen, you have now two choices.
Since you do not look like slave fodder to me I will offer to let you pay to play the game.
If you feel you cannot take part in a slaver's game, I am afraid you will need to... disappear.
entries.target:
这里是鲜血之环！听着，你现在有两个选择。
既然你看起来不像是当奴隶的料，我可以让你付费参加这个游戏。
要是你不愿参加奴隶贩子的游戏，恐怕你就得……消失了。

entries.source: Slavers? This is so wrong! [attack]
entries.target: 奴隶贩子？这太邪恶了！[攻击]

entries.source: You think so? Die.
entries.target: 你这么想？去死吧。

entries.source: Game? I like playing, what's this about?
entries.target: 游戏？我喜欢玩，怎么个玩法？

entries.source:
Well, you see, it's quite simple. I will mentally take control of various wild creatures or slaves while you use the orb of command on the other side of this room to take control of a slave.
Then we fight using our pawns for 10 rounds. If your slave survives you will win the Bloodcaller.
entries.target:
你看，很简单。我会用精神力量控制各种野生生物或奴隶，你则用房间另一头的指令水晶球控制一个奴隶。
然后我们操纵各自的棋子对战10轮。如果你的奴隶活了下来，你就会赢得“鲜血呼唤”。

entries.source: What if I lose?
entries.target: 要是我输了呢？

entries.source: Blood, death without self-harm risks? Great fun!
entries.target: 鲜血和死亡，但自己却不用冒生命危险，太有趣了！

entries.source: Normally you would be taken as a slave, but you look like you would be more useful as a full-time player, so you can just try again.
entries.target: 通常你会被抓去当奴隶，不过看起来，让你当个长期选手会更有用，所以你只管再试一次。

entries.source:
Superb. Oh yes, before I forget, to use the orb you will need to pay the standard fee of 150 gold pieces.
I'm sure this is small money to an adventurer of your class.
entries.target:
好极了。哦，对了，差点忘了：要使用水晶球，你得支付150金币的标准费用。
对你这样的冒险家来说，这肯定不过是九牛一毛。

entries.source: 150 gold? Err... yes, sure.
entries.target: 150金币？呃……对，当然。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You place your hands on the orb.*#WHITE#
You must provide 150 gold to take part in the fight.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你把双手放在水晶球上。*#WHITE#
你必须支付150金币参加比赛。

entries.source: [Pay 150 gold]
entries.target: [支付150金币]

entries.source: [Leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source: Let the fight start!
entries.target: 比赛开始吧！

entries.source: Bring it on!
entries.target: 尽管来吧！

entries.source:
So, you tasted blood? Liked it? I am sure you did; you are just that kind of people.
Anyway, I suppose you deserve your reward.
You can always participate again for fun, if you've got the gold to spare.
entries.target:
那么，你尝到鲜血的滋味了？喜欢吗？我敢说你一定喜欢；你就是那种人。
总之，我想你配得上这份奖赏。
只要你还有闲钱，随时可以再来参加，找点乐子。

entries.source: Thanks, it was fun!
entries.target: 谢谢，非常有趣！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a cute little orange cat. It looks hungry and looks at you.*#WHITE#
Meowww?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一只可爱的橘色小猫。它看起来饿了，正眼巴巴地望着你。*#WHITE#
喵呜呜？

entries.source: Oh kitty kitty!
entries.target: 哦，小猫咪，小猫咪！

entries.source: No time for cats!
entries.target: 我可没时间逗猫！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*It rubs up against your leg and purrs.*#WHITE#
Rrrrrrrrrrrr.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*它蹭着你的腿，打起了呼噜。*#WHITE#
呼噜噜噜噜噜。

entries.source: Hey maybe you would like some of this delicious lookin troll intestines? #LIGHT_GREEN#[Feed him the intestines]#WHITE#
entries.target: 嘿，想不想来点这看起来很美味的巨魔肠子？#LIGHT_GREEN#[把肠子喂给它]#WHITE#

entries.source: Sorry little fellow, I can't help you.
entries.target: 小猫，抱歉，我帮不了你。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*It eats it all and looks happy. After a while it strolls away. Somehow you feel you have not seen the last of it.*#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*它全部吃光了，看起来很开心。过了一会，它溜达着离开了。不知为何，你感觉你还会再见到它。*#WHITE#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Leave]
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[离开]

entries.source: No time to talk fellow Wayist! ATTACK! FOR THE WAY!
entries.target: 没时间说话了，维网信徒同胞！进攻！为了维网！

entries.source: [leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source: The foolish cultist that created me is no more. What am I to do now...
entries.target: 创造我的那个愚蠢邪教徒已经死了。我现在该怎么办……

entries.source: You are me, come with me!
entries.target: 你就是我，和我一起走吧！

entries.source: You should head back to Irkkk.
entries.target: 你应该回伊尔克去。

entries.source: I fear that would get confusing very fast. I think I will go back to Irkkk. Farewell my clone!
entries.target: 恐怕那样很快就会乱套。我想我还是回伊尔克去吧。再见了，我的克隆！

entries.source: Clone? No you are the clone.
entries.target: 克隆？不，你才是克隆。

entries.source: Farewell.
entries.target: 再见。

entries.source: Sure... if you prefer to think about it this way. We are all part of The Way anyway.
entries.target: 啊……如果你愿意这么想也没问题。反正，我们都是维网的一份子。

entries.source: I think so too, farewell my clone.
entries.target: 我也是这么想的，再见了，我的克隆。

entries.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature slowly turns to you. You hear its terrible voice directly in your head.#WHITE#*
Welcome, master.
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物慢慢转向你。你听到它可怕的声音直接在你脑海中响起。#WHITE#*
欢迎你，主人。

entries.source: What are you, and what is this place?
entries.target: 你是什么东西？这是什么地方？

entries.source: Master? I am not your mas...
entries.target: 主人？我不是你的主……

entries.source: Why do I understand you? The texts are unreadable to me.
entries.target: 为什么我能听懂你的话？那些文字我根本看不懂。

entries.source: What can I do here?
entries.target: 我能在这里做什么？

entries.source: What else can this place do?
entries.target: 这里还能做什么？

entries.source: Would it be possible to improve my Cloak of Deception so I do not need to wear it to pass as a living being?
entries.target: 可以升级我的欺诈斗篷，让我不必穿戴它也能伪装成活物吗？

entries.source: You asked me to come, about a farportal?
entries.target: 你叫我来，是为了远行传送门？

entries.source: You asked me to come, about the rod of recall?
entries.target: 你叫我来，是为了回归之杖？

entries.source: Would it be possible for my Transmogrification Chest to automatically extract gems?
entries.target: 可以让我的转化之盒自动提取宝石吗？

entries.source: Are there any training facilities?
entries.target: 这里是不是有一间训练室？

entries.source: Can you use your magic to alter the appearance of my gear?
entries.target: 你能用魔法改变我装备的外形吗？

entries.source: I find your appearance unsettling. Any way you can change it?
entries.target: 你的样子让我感到不安，你能改变一下外形吗？

entries.source: I have come upon a strange thing indeed. #LIGHT_GREEN#[tell him about Melinda]
entries.target: 我的确遇到了一件奇怪的事。#LIGHT_GREEN#[告诉它梅琳达的事]

entries.source: [leave]
entries.target: [离开]

entries.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You possess a control rod. You are the master.
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你拥有一根控制棒，你就是主人。

entries.source: Err... ok.
entries.target: 哦……好吧。

entries.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master; you have the rod. I am created to speak to the master.
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你是主人；你有那根棒。我被创造出来，就是为了与主人交谈。

entries.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you with intensity. You 'see' images in your head.
You see titanic wars in an age now forgotten. You see armies of what you suppose are Sher'Tuls since they look like the shadow.
They fight with weapons, magic and other things. They fight gods. They hunt them down, killing or banishing them.
You see great fortresses like this one, flying all over the skies of Eyal - shining bastions of power glittering in the young sun.
You see the gods beaten, defeated and dead. All but one.
Then you see darkness; it seems like the shadow does not know what followed those events.

You shake your head as the vision dissipates, and your normal sight comes back slowly.
#WHITE#*
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物集中精神注视着你，你“看到”了脑海中的影像。
你看到了发生在一个早已被遗忘的时代里的浩大战争。你看到一支支军队，猜想他们是夏·图尔人，因为他们的外形与堡垒之影相似。
他们用武器、魔法和其他事物作战。他们与众神交战，追猎众神，将其杀死或放逐。
你看到一座座与这里相似的宏伟堡垒飞遍埃亚尔的天空——这些力量强大的璀璨堡垒在尚且年轻的太阳下熠熠生辉。
你看到众神都被击败、杀死，除了一个。
随后你看到了黑暗；似乎堡垒之影并不知道那些事件之后发生了什么。

你摇了摇头，驱散了脑海中的影像，眼前慢慢恢复了现实的景象。
#WHITE#*

entries.source: Those are Sher'Tuls? They fought the gods?!
entries.target: 那是夏·图尔？他们和众神战斗？！

entries.source: They had to. They forged terrible weapons of war. They won.
entries.target: 他们别无选择。他们锻造了可怕的战争武器。他们胜利了。

entries.source: But then where are they now if they won?
entries.target: 他们是胜利了，但是现在他们又在哪里呢？

entries.source: They are gone now. I cannot tell you more.
entries.target: 他们已经消失，我不能告诉你更多了。

entries.source: But I am the master!
entries.target: 我是你的主人！

entries.source: Fine.
entries.target: 好吧。

entries.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master. You can use this place as you desire. However, most of the energies are depleted and only some rooms are usable.
To the south you will find the storage room.
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你是主人，可以随意使用这里。不过，这里的能量大多已经耗尽，只有少数房间还能使用。
南面是储藏室。

entries.source: Thanks.
entries.target: 多谢。

entries.source:
This Fortress is designed as a mobile base for the Godslayers - it can fly.
It is also equiped with various facilities: exploratory farportal, emergency containment field, remote storage, ...
However, the Fortress is badly damaged and has lain dormant for too long. Its energies are nearly depleted.
Take this Transmogrification Chest. It is linked by a permanent farportal to the Fortress. Any item you put inside will be sent to the power core and dismantled for energy.
There are, however, unwanted byproducts to this operation: the generation of a metal known as gold. It is of no use to the Fortress and thus will be sent back to you.
entries.target:
这座堡垒被设计为弑神者的移动基地——它能够飞行。
它还配备了各种设施：探索用远行传送门、紧急遏制力场、远程储藏……
然而，堡垒损毁严重，又休眠了太久，能量已近乎耗尽。
拿着这个转化之盒。它通过一座永久远行传送门与堡垒相连。你放入其中的任何物品都会被送往能量核心，拆解成能量。
不过，这个过程会产生一种不需要的副产物：名为黄金的金属。堡垒用不上它，因此会将它送还给你。

entries.source: I will, thanks.
entries.target: 我收下了，谢谢。

entries.source: I have already found such a chest in my travel. Will it work?
entries.target: 我在旅途中已经找到过一个这样的转化之盒。它能用吗？

entries.source:
Yes, it will. I will attune it to this fortress.
Done.
entries.target:
可以。我会将它与这座堡垒调谐。
好了。

entries.source: Thanks.
entries.target: 多谢。

entries.source:
Long ago the Sher'tuls used farportals not only for transportation to known locations, but also to explore new parts of the world, or even other worlds.
This Fortress is equipped with an exploratory farportal, and now has enough energy to allow one teleportation. Each teleportation will take you to a random part of the universe and use 45 energy.
Beware that the return portal may not be nearby your arrival point; you will need to find it. You can use the rod of recall to try to force an emergency recall, but it has high chances of breaking the exploratory farportal forever.
You may use the farportal; however, beware - I sense a strange presence in the farportal room.
entries.target:
很久以前，夏·图尔使用远行传送门不仅是为了前往已知地点，还会用它探索世界的未知区域，甚至其他世界。
这座堡垒配备了一座探索用远行传送门，现在已有足够能量进行一次传送。每次传送都会把你送往宇宙中的随机区域，并消耗 45 点能量。
注意，返回传送门可能不在抵达点附近，你需要自行寻找。你可以用回归之杖尝试紧急强制返回，但这很可能会永久损坏探索用远行传送门。
你现在可以使用这座远行传送门；不过要小心——我感觉传送门房间里有某种异常存在。

entries.source: I will check it out, thanks.
entries.target: 我会去检查一下的，谢谢。

entries.source:
The rod of recall you possess is not a Sher'tul artifact, but it is based on Sher'tul design.
The Fortress now has enough energy to upgrade it. It can be changed to recall you to the Fortress.
entries.target:
你所拥有的回归之杖并非夏·图尔造物，但它采用了夏·图尔的设计。
堡垒现在有足够的能量来升级它。升级后，它便能将你传送回堡垒。

entries.source: I like it the way it is now. Thanks anyway.
entries.target: 我喜欢它现在的样子，不过还是谢谢了。

entries.source: That could be quite useful. Yes, please do it.
entries.target: 这很有用。好，就这么办。

entries.source:
Yes master, a training facility is available to the north, but it is not yet powered on.
I will need to use 50 energy to do this.
entries.target:
是的，主人。北面有一处训练设施，但尚未通电。
我需要消耗 50 点能量来启动它。

entries.source: Maybe later.
entries.target: 以后再说。

entries.source:
Yes master, the Mirror of Reflections is what you need. It is currently dormant but could be re-activated.
I will need to use 10 energy to do this.
entries.target:
是的，主人。你需要的是反射之镜。它目前处于休眠状态，但可以重新激活。
我需要消耗 10 点能量来启动它。

entries.source: #{italic}##CRIMSON#This feature is purely cosmetic is available only to donators/buyers. You can unlock the room and use the preview but you will not be able to validate your choices.#{normal}#
entries.target: #{italic}##CRIMSON#此功能纯粹用于改变外观，且仅限捐赠者/购买者使用。你可以解锁房间并进行预览，但无法应用你的选择。#{normal}#
